# `theta_difference`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
theta_difference(first, second)
```

Subtracts two binary representations of
Datasketches ThetaSketch objects from two input columns using a
ThetaSketch AnotB object.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT theta_sketch_estimate(theta_difference(theta_sketch_agg(col1), theta_sketch_agg(col2))) FROM VALUES (5, 4), (1, 4), (2, 5), (2, 5), (3, 1) tab(col1, col2);
```

Result:

```text
2
```
